specs.Item Type Name: ZEBRONICS Newly Launched Blanc Wireless Mouse with 2.4GHz+ BT, Multicolor LED Lights, Silent Operation, 4 Buttons Plug & Play.

features: The Zeb-Blanc, with its sleek and stylish design, is incredibly lightweight at only 63g. This wireless mouse is convenient to carry and well-suited for everyday use
The mouse works well with dual-mode seamless wireless connection of 2.4GHz and BT which can keep you intact at work
Has an advanced optical sensor with adjustable DPI up to 1600DPI for smooth cursor movements with reliably utmost precision
A detachable nano receiver USB attached to the bottom panel is the key component for easy plug-and-play
A built-in rechargeable battery in the mouse makes its use much more convenient
